criteria.clarity: The intended visible action and resulting state must remain identifiable in the same brief. State the specific task before review.
criteria.factual_causality: Initiator, trigger, contact/transfer, process state and consequence remain truthful and distinct. Do not derive a technical result from gesture duration. An absence claim requires every decoded frame across its preregistered event interval.
criteria.mascot_style: Latest user direction: flat, front-facing 2D mascot; preserve identity, attached anatomy and four feet. Side/rear poses excluded. No depth/perspective art promotion.
criteria.phone_readability: Inspect whole native 360x640 frames: primary captions, relevant secondary labels, objects, clipping and occlusion. A visibility gain cannot compensate for a label or contact regression.
criteria.contact: Required wrist/hand/prop/support relations remain readable and valid through declared event intervals. Numeric attachment proofs and static samples have separate limits.
criteria.technical_reliability: Exact versions, setup validation, finite state, reproducible repeated/out-of-order sampling, correct event times, runtime and encoded output integrity. Preserve inherited warnings; no newly unexplained failure.

rules: Freeze brief, artifact identities, component versions, criteria and event intervals before execution.
At most one new component per stage; compare each stage with both original and last good.
All six guardrails; no aggregate aesthetic score. A gain must be demonstrated against every required comparator.
One reproducible hard regression blocks this combination; reviewer disagreement or inadequate coverage is inconclusive.
A source-only pass cannot approve painted/perceived quality. Timing, motion and audio gains need suitable full-speed picture and listening evidence.
Byte-identical artifacts may support output-preserving technical refactors within their exact artifact type; source-state equality is not encoded pixel or AV equality.
A tie is no promotion; preserve research, reports, failures and last-good artifacts.
No automated Git promotion, merge, push, deployment, credential or account actions.
